title: Server Blob/set destroy via jmap-blob-server
description: Follow-up of mimid-1wgh.14.2 (decision mimid-1wgh.67, reading d). crate-jmap at the pinned rev fe13c651 has draft-ietf-jmap-blobext-03 Blob/set destroy in jmap-blob-server (BlobBackend::destroy_blob), but registering it needs a full BlobBackend for mimid-server (urn:ietf:params:jmap:blob2 capability, Blob/get, lookup, convert, upload, copy). RFC 8620 itself defines no blob deletion. Would let a sender delete an attachment early (e.g. after retracting its message).
